title: Immunogenicity Dataset v5 Schema
description: Standard schema for SESTRAV v5 datasets. Extends v4 with provenance columns (virus_family, negative_origin, assay_type, assay_quality_weight, assay_quality_tier, reference_pmid, iedb_assay_id, virus_taxon_id), per-virus biology context (infection_phase, antigen_latency_program, cross_reactivity_tested), and singleton quarantine flag (is_quarantined). All additions are nullable and not required. v4 is frozen; v5 is the Phase 2 research/depth dataset.

peptide.description: The amino acid sequence of the peptide. MHC Class I canonical length: 8-11 residues.

label.description: Immunogenicity label. 1 for positive (immunogenic), 0 for negative (non-immunogenic or decoy).

virus.description: Legacy field. Original source virus/pathogen if applicable (e.g., EBV, HPV). In v5, HPV16/HPV18 are normalized to HPV with strain set accordingly.

protein.description: Original protein name the peptide is derived from.

strain.description: Specific strain of the pathogen if applicable. In v5, HPV strain is set to HPV16, HPV18, or HPV_generic as appropriate.

hla_allele.description: The MHC Class I allele the peptide is presented by (e.g., HLA-A*02:01).

source_type.description: The generalized origin of the peptide (Virus, Tumor, Self).

database_source.description: The database from which the sequence was retrieved (e.g., IEDB, VDJdb, UniProt, dbPepNeo).

tcr_alpha_cdr3.description: CDR3 alpha chain (TRA) sequence from VDJdb. Null for non-VDJdb sources or when not recorded. Required for Phase 5 TCR repertoire matching.

tcr_beta_cdr3.description: CDR3 beta chain (TRB) sequence from VDJdb. Null for non-VDJdb sources or when not recorded. Required for Phase 5 TCR repertoire matching.

virus_family.description: Taxonomic family of the source virus (e.g., Herpesviridae, Coronaviridae, Papillomaviridae). Null for non-viral sources (Self decoys, tumor). Used for virus-family-aware modeling experiments.

negative_origin.description: Origin of negative-labeled rows. Null for positive rows. Critical for negative-set ablation experiments (Q4).

assay_type.description: IEDB assay type classification (e.g., T cell, B cell). Null for synthetic rows.

assay_quality_weight.description: Quality weight assigned at ingestion: 1.0 for direct functional assays (T cell IFN-gamma ELISpot, MHC multimer), 0.7 for indirect assays, 0.5 for computational or low-confidence. Null for synthetic rows.

reference_pmid.description: PubMed ID of the primary publication supporting this row. Required for all IEDB-sourced rows; null for synthetic decoys.

is_quarantined.description: True if this row's virus has fewer than 50 rows or fewer than 10 real tested negatives in v5. Quarantined rows are excluded from per-virus training and per-virus metrics but retained in the file for traceability.

iedb_assay_id.description: Persistent IEDB assay/reference record identifier (Reference ID or Assay ID) for row-level provenance. Set by ingest_iedb_negatives.py; null for non-IEDB rows (decoys, published panels without an IEDB record).

assay_quality_tier.description: Integer companion to assay_quality_weight for clean stratification queries. 1 = direct ex vivo functional assay (weight 1.0); 2 = indirect/other (0.7); 3 = expanded-culture protocol (0.5). Null for synthetic rows.

infection_phase.description: Infection phase for viruses whose epitope hierarchy depends on it (HBV: acute vs chronic generate distinct hierarchies, Thimme 2003 J Exp Med). Null when not applicable or unknown.

antigen_latency_program.description: EBV antigen expression program. Lytic vs latency-I/II/III express different antigen sets; most IEDB EBV is lytic. Pooling latency programs is a known trap. Null when not applicable or unknown.

cross_reactivity_tested.description: HPV only: True if an HPV16/18 epitope was explicitly tested against both strains; False if cross-reactivity was assumed. Null when not applicable. Required before pooled HPV training is biologically defensible.

virus_taxon_id.description: NCBI Taxonomy ID for the source virus (e.g., EBV=10376, HPV16=333760). Controlled vocabulary for virus names; required for FAIR/Zenodo compliance. Null for non-viral sources.
